config.notes: The user-data directory has the same layout on both platforms: Preferences, Bookmarks, extensions and per-profile directories all carry over. Cookies and saved passwords are sealed with the Windows DPAPI, so those are re-entered on Linux; they are secrets anyway and travel only with --secrets. Google ships no package for the Debian, Fedora, openSUSE or Alpine repositories; on Linux it comes from the AUR or Flathub.
